senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unreproached, respectable.
E.
अ neg. कुत्सित bad.

n. (-प्यं)
Gold or silver.
E.
अ neg. and कुण base metal.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Low, mean, of low family.
E.
अ neg. कुल family.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Confounded, confused, flurried.
2 Confused (in order), disordered.
3 Incoherent, contradictory.
E.
आङ्, कुल to accumulate, and क affix; not self-possessed.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Low, mean, of low origin or race.
E.
अ neg. कुलीन of family.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Unlucky, inauspicious.
2 Clumsy, not clever.
E.
अ neg. कुशल lucky, clever.

m. (-रः)
1 The sea or ocean.
2 A tortoise.
3 The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world.
4 A stone or rock.
E.
अ neg. कू the earth, and पृ to cherish, or अ neg. कू for कुत्सित contemptible, vile, and पार bank, boundary: there are other etymologies, and वृ being substituted for पृ, the word is sometimes written अकूवार.

m. (-र्च्चः)
A deified saint, according to the Bauddhas.
mfn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्चा-र्च्चं)
Void of guile.
E.
अ priv. and कूर्च्च fraud.

n. (-नं)
1 Compression, contraction, shrinking.
2 Collecting, heaping.
3 Curving, flexure.
4 Contortion.
E.
आङ् before कुचि to contract, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bent, contracted.
2 Twisted, contorted.
E.
आङ् before कुचि to contract, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Confounded, abashed.
E.
आङ् before कुण्ठित abashed.

n. (-त्वं)
Confusion, perplexity, bewilderment.
E.
आकुल and त्व affix; also with तल् affix आकुलता.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bewildered, flurried, agitated.
2 Distressed.
E.
आङ् before कुल, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bewildered, perplexed.
E.
आकुल and कृत made with च्चि aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Expelled, extracted.
E.
आकुष to extract, क्त aff.

n. (-तं)
1 Meaning, intention.
2 Wish, desire.
E.
आङ्, कूङ to cry, affix क्त.
